assumptions.statement: All proposal ratios use the submitted overall_design_area geometry (11,412,825.386 sqm, reported as 11.41 km² at stage-2 precision) as denominator. The coordinated_research_area (43.61 km² context) is never a denominator.
assumptions.impact: green_ratio and public_space_ratio can be recalculated without mixing the two official scope concepts; replacement official geometry requires regeneration of every dependent result.

assumptions.statement: SITE-001 and PROV-KEY-001..003 retain the repository provisional geometries; they are not official redlines, cadastral boundaries, road redlines, or approval evidence.
assumptions.impact: Design geometries are transferable concept references only and must be regenerated after cleared official CAD/GIS/PDF boundaries are obtained.

assumptions.statement: The three key-area area_sqm_declared values are read directly from ranges/planning_limits.json: 1,921,000 / 1,043,000 / 720,000 sqm. No provisional rectangle is measured for those official area values.
assumptions.impact: Geometry supports provisional location context while official announced values remain a separate, traceable quantity.

assumptions.statement: Agent-generated polygons and lines follow the executable normalized-axis, buffer, node, module, partition, and phase parameters in _AI工作区/build_geometry.py; there is no random or traversal-order selection.
assumptions.impact: Every declared proposal area and every known metric can be regenerated deterministically in EPSG:4548 from the serialized GeoJSON.

assumptions.statement: OSM landuse=residential boundaries are emitted only as clipped analysis-helper lines for field-verification leads. They are low confidence, not regulatory controls or findings of households, tenure, vulnerability, ownership, loss, or causation.
assumptions.impact: No OSM feature has a declared area and no OSM geometry enters any area, length, ratio, redline, control, compensation, or responsibility metric.

assumptions.statement: COST-SCREEN-001 is an agent-generated audit envelope: each later intervention must register beneficiary, screened interface, mitigation action, proposed duty holder, trigger, deadline, and human verification before professional design proceeds.
assumptions.impact: The layer structures accountability but does not claim that impact, compensation, funding, or responsible parties have been officially determined.

assumptions.statement: Floor-area ratio, building height, statutory building density, statutory green ratio, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, engineering constraints, affected-household count, and mitigation budget remain unknown.
assumptions.impact: Approved regulatory conditions, cleared survey/ownership data, field verification, reviewed unit costs, affected-party process, and human approval are required before any of those values can be filled.
